predictions: Dangit! After starting the season with five straight weeks of 17+ correct picks, I now have four straight weeks with only 15 or 16 correct. Got my third 16-9 record last week, mostly due to stupid B and G divisions, where I was a combined 1-5. As per usual, 7 of my 9 incorrect picks flipped or tied on a single dart, but if you look at the scores up and down page 2 most weeks, you can see just how close so many matches are each and every week. Stupid membership director has some serious balance going on, and that makes life hard on this page. That takes me to 149-76 (66.2% correct), which is… ok-ish. Gotta step it up soon.

Match of the week: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. With Death Throw falling last week, the G race is alive again. Had We Throw It not also stumbled last week, this pairing would be full-on marquee worthy this week. Instead, I think this one is Machine squeaking one out and putting another contender in the rear view, 13-11.

Match #2: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Menace 2 Sobriety. There are roughly 874 teams fighting for 2nd place in D, and this pair is among those at the lead of that throng. Menace is presently in the better spot, and they won last time around, but man… when was the last time they weren't shorthanded? And amazingly, neither of these teams have scored more than 14 in any match so far. Menace… I guess? 11-10?

Matches #3, #4 and #5: (B Div.) Mulligans Mafia @ Darty Minds; Projectile Dysfunction @ Buffalo Bulls; Liquor Possee @ Kids On The Fringe. Ah, B division… B division, B division, B division… where every team has 3-5 wins, and every team has 2-5 losses. And where I am 0-6 in picks over the last two weeks. Where anything can happen (and by "anything," I mean "the opposite of what Jason writes"). So who shall we doom this week? Let's take Darty to keep hold of the division lead, 15-9; let's take Projectile's DCkt dominance, 14-10; and let's hand Possee their 4th loss in their last five matches… Kids, 13-11.
Match #6: (A Div.) Wing & a Plaque @ Consistently Inconsistent. Being an A team is a big deal in RDL hierarchy, and this one might well be a head-to-head matchup for an A spot in the fall. CI, 13-11.
Match #7: (F Div.) Runs with Corks @ Shark Shooters. The Corks lead F, but have a big test here in the 3rd place Shooters. They can knock out one of their competitors for good here. Corkers, 15-9.
Match #8: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ The Hunted Element. Element's turn to get tested by the new top-four-in-the-league squad. Won't be easy, but I'm still thinking my guys stay rolling. Element, 16-8.

Match #9: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Breakfast Club. Area has dusted this division, but the other seven teams are waging a pretty great battle. These teams could finish 2nd, or could head to E. Rif Raf it is, 15-9.

Match #10: (F Div.) Rippin Darts @ One Time. Just like match #7 above, we have one of the F leaders facing one of the near chase group. One Time is on a three-match roll, so let's make it four, 14-10.
Match #11: (H Div.) Double Vision @ 21 Dart Salute. Should the league expand again next season, this one might end up being big in determining who drops to I. Foreigner says Double Vision, 13-11.
Match #12: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Big Duck Energy. Is this important in the race to avoid D next season? Or the race for 2nd this season? I'm going with… yes. Tell me some Secrets, 13-11.
